在[From.GetName]的地壳深处，埋藏着一些不完整的化石残骸，似乎是曾居住在[From.GetStarName]星系之中的以太巨龙的近亲。

这位以太巨龙的表亲死后，经过漫长的岁月，其柔软的身体组织已经硬化成石头，其骨骼也变得坚硬无比，形成了矿物一样的内部结构。
excerpt.en:

label.zh: 骸骨与龙蛋（各自独立，随机在1天至50年内触发）
label.en: Bones and egg (independent, each 1 day to 50 years later)

note.zh: 在宝藏行星建成采矿站时，隐藏事件 660 同时为两者各排期（1天+随机18000天）。一旦行星标记 deboned / deegged，各自只触发一次。若星系易手，隐藏事件 662 重新排期。
note.en: When a mining station is built on the hoard planet, hidden 660 (on_building_mining_station, 00_on_actions.txt:1884) schedules each separately (1 day plus up to 18000 random days). Each fires once per planet (flags deboned/deegged); 662 reschedules them if the system changes hands.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地壳深处，埋藏着一些不完整的化石残骸，似乎是曾居住在[From.GetStarName]星系之中的以太巨龙的近亲。

这位以太巨龙的表亲死后，经过漫长的岁月，其柔软的身体组织已经硬化成石头，其骨骼也变得坚硬无比，形成了矿物一样的内部结构。
texts.en:
Buried deep in the crust of [From.GetName] are the partial, fossilized remains of what appears to have been a close relative to the Ether Drake that once dwelled in the [From.GetStarName] system.

In the eons since this cousin-Drake's passing, its soft tissues have ossified and its bones indurated, becoming mineral-like in structure.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项 a「研究」授予龙甲（grant_dragon_armor_effect），选项 b「磨碎」给予每月矿物与社会研究加成；均不通向其他事件。
notes.en: Review note: option a grants dragon armour (grant_dragon_armor_effect), option b gives monthly minerals and society research; neither leads to another event (leviathans_events_1.txt:8824-8843).

texts.zh:
当我们围绕龙之宝藏运行的开采站正在重新定位以对准一条资源极其丰富的矿脉时，传感器侦测到其中仍有些我们尚未发现的东西。

一个完好无损的以太巨龙的蛋被埋在小行星的地表下，周围散落着一些运气相较不那么好的同类的被碾碎的蛋壳。蛋已经从矿坑里挖出来了，但是它未来的命运还悬而未决。
texts.en:
As our mining station orbiting Dragon's Hoard was repositioning to align with a particularly rich mineral vein, sensors picked up something that had hitherto gone undetected.

An undamaged Ether Drake egg in pristine condition, buried beneath the surface of the planetoid and surrounded by the smashed shells of several less fortunate specimens. The egg has been excavated and removed from the mining site, but its ultimate fate remains undecided.

label.zh: 如果能培育出一头小以太龙，我们就能得到强大的伙伴……
label.en: A young Ether Drake would make a formidable ally...

label.zh: 既然消灭了它，就不要留后患。
label.en: The last one was killed for a reason.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项 a 在首都启用孵化项目；选项 b 立刻获得300影响力。项目花费50000社会研究点，限时1800天（超时失败 → 665）。
notes.en: Review note: option a enables the incubation project at the capital; option b gives 300 influence at once (leviathans_events_1.txt:8906-8922). The project costs 50000 and has a 1800-day limit; timing out gives 665 (00_projects_leviathans.txt:430-448).

texts.zh:
这颗在龙巢中发现的蛋仍然显示出微弱的生命迹象。我们的科学家认为，模拟龙蛋的孵化环境并最终成功孵化是可行的。然而，我们就算成功孵化了龙蛋，得到的以太龙几乎不可能拥有与其先祖相同的大小和力量，但是如果我们对其进行合理的驯养，这仍然会是我们不可估量资产。

这颗龙蛋脱离了龙巢不能存活太久，我们必须加快行动了。
texts.en:
The egg recovered from the Dragon's Hoard still shows faint signs of life. It should be possible to deduce and emulate an ideal incubation environment for the egg, with the goal of eventually hatching it. Should we be successful in hatching the egg, the resulting Ether Drake is unlikely to match its ancestors in size or power, but with proper domestication will undoubtedly prove to be an incredible asset.

The egg will not last long outside of the environment it was found in. We must act quickly.

tooltips.zh: 幼年以太巨龙塞尔加入了[Root.Owner.GetName]的舰队。
tooltips.en: Young Ether Drake Scile joins the fleets of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

note.zh: 生成一支以太幼龙舰队“Scile”（不占舰队容量），设置 hatched_dragon。
note.en: Spawns an Ether hatchling fleet (no fleet capacity) and sets hatched_dragon.

texts.zh:
负责龙蛋的外星生物学家表示，从龙之宝藏小行星回收的以太巨龙的蛋已经过了孵化期限。

孵化以太龙的计划已经没有任何希望了。
texts.en:
The Ether Drake egg recovered from the Dragon's Hoard planetoid has, in the words of the xenobiologist in charge of the ovum, passed its expiry date.

There is no longer any hope of hatching the creature within.

texts.zh:
从名为龙之宝藏的小行星回收的以太巨龙的蛋已经无法孵化。

这个种群灭绝了。
texts.en:
The Ether Drake egg recovered from the Dragon's Hoard planetoid can no longer be considered viable.

The species is extinct.

texts.zh: 以太巨龙的蛋中止了。生物进程已崩溃，且无可用的错误报告用于调试。
texts.en: The Ether Drake egg is terminated. Biological processes have crashed, and there are no available error reports for debugging.

label.en: The egg is no longer viable

summary.text:
# 龙之宝藏 / Dragon's Hoard

- 分类 Category：巨兽与城邦 · 来源 Sources：events/leviathans_events_1.txt:8764-9001（660-665）; common/special_projects/00_projects_leviathans.txt:430-448; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1884, :4251 · DLC：利维坦 Leviathans · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts
在以太巨龙守护的“宝藏”小行星上建成采矿站（on_building_mining_station → 隐藏 660），或所在星系易主（on_system_gained → 隐藏 662）。隐藏事件分别为骸骨和龙蛋排期（1天 + 最多约50年随机）。
A mining station on the Hoard planet (or a change of system ownership) schedules the two events separately.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline
- 661 “龙之坟墓”（骸骨）：研究（得到龙甲）或磨碎（每月矿物+社会研究）。
- 663 “龙之后代”（龙蛋）：a 在首都启用“孵化龙蛋”项目（5万点，限时1800天）；b 获得300影响力。
- 两者互相独立，每颗行星各触发一次（标记 deboned / deegged）。
- 项目成功 → 664 龙蛋孵化（生成以太幼龙舰队）；失败 → 665 龙蛋已死。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes
成功孵化（664）；超时失败（665）；放弃龙蛋（663.b）。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants
665 的文本随蜂巢/机器帝国变化。

## 审阅记录 Review notes
合并 event-leviathans-660 / -662。已核对触发、项目参数和结局。完整。
Merged two one-doc stories; checked triggers, project parameters and outcomes. Complete.
